q: How do I place an order?
a: Add products to your enquiry list, or just tell us what you need on the Contact page. We call or message you to confirm what's available, the price and a delivery day. Nothing is charged online.

q: Which areas do you deliver to?
a: For now, Thimphu (Tuesday and Friday), Paro (Wednesday) and Punakha–Wangdue (Saturday). If you live elsewhere, send an enquiry anyway and we will tell you honestly whether we can reach you.
Once we confirm your order, you can pay cash on delivery or by mobile banking transfer such as mBoB. We send the account details with your confirmation.

We do not claim organic certification. What we can tell you is who grew each product, where, and how they farm, in their own words. If you want to know more about a particular product, ask us and we will find out from the farmer.
Vegetables and fruit are picked as close to your delivery day as we can arrange, usually within one to three days. Grains, honey and dried goods are from the most recent season.

q: Can hotels and restaurants order regularly?
a: Yes. Choose 'Business' on the enquiry form, tell us what you need each week, and we will put together a supply plan based on what our farmers expect to harvest.

q: What if something I asked for is not available?
a: Harvests depend on the weather. If something is short, we tell you before delivery and suggest what is fresh instead. You only pay for what you receive.

q: I am a farmer. How can I sell through Druk Harvest?
a: Choose 'Farmer / Supplier' on the enquiry form, or call us. Tell us what you grow and roughly how much. We visit, talk about quality and quantity, and agree terms together before anything is sold.
